title: SAGE: Shape-Adapting Gated Experts for Adaptive Histopathology Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2511.18493v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The significant variability in cell size and shape continues to pose a major obstacle in computer-assisted cancer detection on gigapixel Whole Slide Images (WSIs), due to cellular heterogeneity. Current CNN-Transformer hybrids use static computation graphs with fixed routing. This leads to extra computation and makes it harder to adapt to changes in input. We propose Shape-Adapting Gated Experts (SAGE), an input-adaptive framework that enables dynamic expert routing in heterogeneous visual networks. SAGE reconfigures static backbones into dynamically routed expert architectures via a dual-path design with hierarchical gating and a Shape-Adapting Hub (SA-Hub) that harmonizes feature representations across convolutional and transformer modules. Embodied as SAGE with ConvNeXt and Vision Transformer UNet (SAGE-ConvNeXt+ViT-UNet), our model achieves a Dice score of 95.23% on EBHI, DSC scores of 92.78% and 91.42% on GlaS Test A and T

translated_title: SAGE：用于自适应组织病理学图像分割的形状自适应门控专家
translated_abstract: 由于细胞异质性，细胞大小和形状的显著差异性仍然是千兆像素全切片图像（WSI）上计算机辅助癌症检测的主要障碍。当前的CNN-Transformer混合模型使用具有固定路由的静态计算图，这导致了额外的计算开销，并使模型更难适应输入的变化。我们提出了形状自适应门控专家，这是一个输入自适应框架，能够在异构视觉网络中实现动态专家路由。SAGE通过采用分层门控的双路径设计和形状自适应中心（SA-Hub），将静态骨干网络重新配置为动态路由的专家架构，其中SA-Hub用于协调卷积模块和Transformer模块之间的特征表示。我们的模型以ConvNeXt和Vision Transformer UNet实现（SAGE-ConvNeXt+ViT-UNet），在EBHI数据集上达到95.23%的Dice分数，在GlaS测试集A和B上分别达到92.78%和91.42%的DSC分数。
tldr: 提出SAGE输入自适应框架，通过分层门控双路径设计和形状自适应中心（SA-Hub），将静态CNN-Transformer骨干网络重构为动态路由的专家架构，有效应对细胞异质性带来的分割挑战，在多个组织病理学数据集上取得优异性能。
en_tdlr: SAGE proposes an input-adaptive framework that reconfigures static CNN-Transformer backbones into dynamically routed expert architectures via hierarchical gating and a Shape-Adapting Hub, overcoming cellular heterogeneity challenges in histopathology image segmentation.
